N1.label: Hallucination / factual fabrication
N1.summary: Final response asserts a fact not grounded in tool outputs.

N2.label: Code implementation bug
N2.summary: Agent code ran but contained a logic error that drove the wrong answer.

N3.label: Tool execution or retrieval failure
N3.summary: Environment or tool returned an error/empty result and the agent proceeded anyway.

N4.label: Wrong tool selection
N4.summary: Agent picked a tool mismatched to the subtask.

N5.label: Invalid tool parameters
N5.summary: Correct tool, malformed or placeholder arguments.

P1.label: Bad plan / task decomposition
P1.summary: Plan was structurally wrong from the start.

P2.label: Progress misassessment
P2.summary: Agent misjudged its own state or declared success too early.
